subject: Brightline go‑live: preferred invoice intake channel and example template
messages:
From: Janet Liu <janet.liu@brightline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@brightline.com
Date: 2027-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Brightline onboarding — invoice submission options + template attached

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the activation runbook earlier — we’re scheduled to go live next week and have a couple of final questions on the invoice intake path. Our billing team prefers to keep sending invoices via email (accounts-payable@brightline.com) for the first few billing cycles, but we saw your portal option and are open to migrating. Before we finalize, can you confirm:

- Which intake channel Redwood prefers for new vendors (portal API vs. email PDF/CSV)?
- If email is acceptable as a temporary fallback, what is the minimal required schema and preferred subject line so our system can auto-route?
- Do you require PO numbers to be embedded in the invoice filename, subject, or a field? We often pack multiple PO numbers on a single invoice.

I’ve attached the template our billing automation currently emits (Brightline_invoice_template.xlsx) and a sample CSV of line items. We can modify output if you provide a minimal schema.

Attachments: Brightline_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Janet Liu
Billing Manager, Brightline Logistics
janet.liu@brightline.com
+1 415‑555‑0198

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Liu <janet.liu@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-08T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline onboarding — invoice submission options + template attached

Hi Janet — great to see this moving across the finish line. Short answer: portal-first, email-acceptable as a short-term fallback. A few quick notes to make the transition smooth:

- Preferred: Redwood Vendor Portal (idempotent intake, automated acks, PO matching). We can onboard Brightline this week; portal supports CSV/PDF attachments and structured line items.
- Fallback: email to invoices@redwood.ai is fine for the first 1–2 billing cycles while you map fields. We’ll issue an acknowledgement token back to the sending address.
- PO handling: we prefer PO numbers in a discrete field (PO_number) or in the subject using the convention "PO:12345". Multi‑PO invoices are allowed — please provide PO numbers as a pipe-delimited list in the PO_number field.

I’ll let Marissa confirm the minimal schema and sample subject line we need for the email fallback. Sean, can you confirm SLA for ack tokens and the expected mapping cadence?

Next steps: Marissa to share minimal email schema and sample subject; vendor to confirm whether they want to start on email fallback or begin portal onboarding now.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations (Partner Onboarding), Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Janet Liu <janet.liu@brightline.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-09T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline onboarding — invoice submission options + template attached

Hi Janet / team — copying the AP intake requirements below so your engineers can map. We can accept email fallback but we require the following minimal metadata in the message body or as attached CSV/structured metadata so our ingestion can auto-match to your account and POs. Preferred order is to provide a small JSON or CSV attachment; if that’s not possible, include these fields in the top of the email body (key: value).

Minimal required fields (email fallback):
- vendor_id: BRIGHTLINE-001 (we’ll provide your assigned vendor_id after activation)
- invoice_number: unique per vendor per fiscal year
- invoice_date: YYYY-MM-DD
- total_amount: decimals (e.g., 1234.56)
- currency: USD / EUR etc.
- PO_number: pipe-delimited when multiple (e.g., 12345|12346)
- line_item_count: integer (optional for PDF, required for CSV)
- tax_amount: decimals (0.00 allowed)
- remit_to_entity: Redwood, Inc. or entity name to pay
- remit_address: free text
- billing_contact_email: accounts-payable@brightline.com

Email subject preference for fallback: "Invoice from Brightline | invoice_number | PO:12345"

Attachments for email fallback:
- We accept a single CSV for line items (sample attached: sample_line_items.csv). PDF invoices are fine; if you send PDF only, please include the minimal metadata in the email body or filename.

Ack/SLAs:
- We will send an automated acknowledgement (ack token) within 4 business hours for accepted payloads. Rejections will include a short error code.

Edge cases:
- Multi-entity remittance or cross-currency invoices: flag remit_entity and currency per line if applicable; we can route but it increases processing time.
- Electronic signatures / tax jurisdiction: include VAT or tax registration numbers in the metadata.

Attachment: sample_line_items.csv (csv)

If you confirm you’ll start on email fallback, we’ll provision a vendor_id and confirm the ack endpoint by end of day. Otherwise, we can schedule a 30‑minute portal onboarding slot and provision API credentials.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Janet Liu <janet.liu@brightline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline onboarding — invoice submission options + template attached

Thanks Marissa — that schema is very clear and should be straightforward for our billing system to emit. Couple quick clarifications before we finalize mapping:

- Line item CSV vs. PDF: we can emit a CSV attachment for line items (preferred). If we must send PDF-only for a period, we will include the minimal metadata in the email body as you requested.
- Multiple PO behavior: we will include all PO numbers in the PO_number field pipe-delimited; question — do you perform separate matching per PO line (i.e., split the invoice across POs) or do you apply an aggregated matching rule?
- Tax jurisdiction / VAT: for EU shipments we include VAT registration on the invoice header; do you need per-line tax breakout or is a summary tax_amount sufficient for initial processing?

Quoted for context:
> Preferred: Redwood Vendor Portal (idempotent intake, automated acks, PO matching). We can onboard Brightline this week; portal supports CSV/PDF attachments and structured line items.

We’re leaning to start on email fallback for the upcoming cycle, then switch to portal when API credentials are ready. Please provision a vendor_id and ack token when convenient so we can run a test.

Best,
Janet
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Liu <janet.liu@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brightline onboarding — invoice submission options + template attached

Janet — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming plan and owners: 

1) Start with email fallback for the next two invoices while Brightline engineering maps the CSV export. Marissa — please provision vendor_id BRIGHTLINE-001 and reply with the ack endpoint (invoices-ack+br-001@redwood.ai) and the initial ack token TTL.
2) Brightline will include line_items as CSV attachment and include the minimal metadata in the top of the message body per Marissa’s schema. Use subject: "Invoice from Brightline | INV-2027-324 | PO:98765|98766"
3) Sean — please schedule a 30‑minute portal onboarding slot for Monday (2027-08-15) to provision API creds and walk through test payloads; we’ll migrate full intake to portal within two billing cycles.

I’m attaching the onboarding playbook excerpt we referenced for Brightline activation. Links: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/onboarding-playbook#brightline-activation

Attachment: onboarding-playbook.pdf (pdf)

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth cutover.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
